PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Suppose Bella were at row 4, column 5: then the general clue ("There was exactly one person standing in a puddle.") could not be true. So Bella can't be there. So Bella (B) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Suppose Dante were at row 1, column 1: then nobody could stand in row 2. So Dante can't be there. So Dante (D) must be at row 2, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Using the general clue ("There was exactly one person standing in a puddle."), some squares are ruled out for Colin. So Colin (C) must be at row 4, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Elsa that fits her clue ("She was alone in the Station Cafe."). So Elsa (E) must be at row 3, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: Vince is now the only person who can still go in column 4. So Vince (the victim) must be at row 5, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Amber that fits her clue ("She was not in the Waiting Room."). So Amber (A) must be at row 1, column 6. Cross out her row and column. Bella is the only person in the Waiting Room with Vince, so Bella is the murderer!
